description: Works out the ACoS (ad spend ÷ the sales the ads bring) at which Amazon Sponsored Products pay for themselves: what a unit an ad brings keeps before the ad (after the referral fee, the FBA fee estimate or the label and packaging, storage and the landed cost) as a share of what the buyer pays. Gives it outside peak season and in peak (October 15 to January 14), when the FBA peak fee lowers it. It fits a seller who asks what ACoS they need, whether their Amazon ads pay, or what to bid. Takes the price, category, fba or fbm, the packed size and weight bands or the packed dimensions (FBA) or shipping charged (FBM), and the landed cost. Optional: the monthly ad spend with the ACoS (or the ad sales) for the monthly gain or loss and the fix, and the conversion rate for the highest cost per click that pays. Amazon publishes no ACoS benchmark: the seller's own break-even is the test. The FBA fee and storage are estimates (estimate: true); Amazon's Fee Preview shows a seller's real fee. Assumes the Professional plan. Dated rates with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

acos.description: ACoS, last 30 days (Campaign Manager): ad spend ÷ the sales the ads brought, as a fraction (0.3 is 30%). Or send adSales with adSpend.

adSales.description: Sales the ads brought, last 30 days, US dollars (Campaign Manager). Send with adSpend; the ACoS is adSpend ÷ adSales.

adSpend.description: Sponsored Products spend, last 30 days, US dollars (Campaign Manager). With acos or adSales it gives the monthly gain or loss.

category.description: The Amazon category, which sets the referral fee, or not-sure (Everything Else, 15%, flagged).

conversionRate.description: Orders ÷ clicks on the ads, last 30 days (Campaign Manager), as a fraction (0.1 is 10%). Adds the highest cost per click that still pays.

fulfillment.description: fba (Amazon ships; adds the FBA fee estimate) or fbm (the seller ships).

labelCost.description: FBM: what the shipping label costs, US dollars. Left out: shipping is treated as breaking even (label = shipping charged − packaging), flagged.

landedCost.description: What one unit costs the seller, delivered: product, freight, duties and prep, to Amazon's door (FBA) or the seller's (FBM). US dollars.

packaging.description: FBM: packaging per order, US dollars. Left out: $1, a weakly sourced typical figure, flagged.

packed.description: The packed size and weight, as Amazon measures it: makes the FBA estimate and the size and weight checks exact to the rate card.

weightOz.description: Weight, ounces, packed (16 oz is 1 lb).

price.description: The selling price on Amazon, US dollars.

shippingCharged.description: FBM: what the buyer pays for shipping, US dollars (0 if free). The referral fee is charged on price + shipping. Default 0.

sizeBand.description: FBA: small-flat (fits 15 × 12 × 0.75 in), standard-box (up to 18 × 14 × 8 in) or bigger. Send with weightBand, or send packed.

weightBand.description: FBA: the packed weight band (the top of the band is used; over-3lb has no top, so it is billed from 3 lb and heavier items cost more: send packed for a closer number). Send with sizeBand.

acos.description: The ACoS used, as a fraction.

acosFrom.description: typed: the acos sent; ad_sales: adSpend ÷ adSales.

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

byDimensionalWeight.description: True when the packed size bills more than the item weighs (dimensional weight).

cardFee.description: The rate card's fee before the surcharge and peak, US dollars.

overmax.description: Overmax handling per unit, US dollars (extra-large over 96 in long or 130 in length + girth); 0 otherwise. In both seasons' FBA fee.

peakAdd.description: What the holiday peak adds to the card for this size and weight row, before the surcharge, US dollars.

fba.description: FBA only: an estimate from Amazon's 2026 rate cards for the size given. Fee Preview in Seller Central shows the real fee.

label.description: The label cost counted per order, US dollars.

labelGiven.description: False when labelCost was left out: the label is then counted as shipping charged − packaging, never below 0.

note.description: When labelCost was left out: what was counted, in words; the seller's own label cost would replace it.

fbmLabel.description: FBM only: the label and packaging counted per order.

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

notes.description: What the break-even leaves out or assumes, whatever was sent.

adSales.description: adSpend ÷ ACoS, a month (or the adSales sent).

breakEvenAcos.description: keptBeforeAds ÷ orderTotal: the ads pay for themselves at this ACoS or lower. Null when each unit loses money before the ad.

earnedAfterCosts.description: What those ad sales keep before the ad: ad sales × breakEvenAcos (0 when each unit loses money before the ad), a month.

estimate.description: True when keptBeforeAds rests on an estimated fee (the FBA fee, storage, which depend on the size and stock Amazon measures): say "about".

fbaFee.description: All-in FBA fee per unit (card × 1.035, with the peak fee in peak). Estimate; 0 for FBM.

additive.description: False when this fix's value is part of another fix's, not on top of it.

estimate.description: True when the fix's dollars rest on an estimated fee (Amazon's, by the size and stock Amazon measures): say "about" and "estimated" when quoting it.

monthly.description: What the fix is worth a month in US dollars, at the seller's numbers, if orders hold; null when no monthly total can be known.

ordersCanFall.description: How far orders could fall (a fraction) before the fix leaves the seller worse off; null when there's no limit or it doesn't apply.

text.description: The fix in plain words, with its condition ("if orders hold").

keptBeforeAds.description: What a unit an ad brings keeps before the ad: order total − fees − label and packaging − storage − landed cost. The Professional plan's monthly fee is left out (one more sale doesn't change it). Also the most an ad can cost per sale.

labelAndPackaging.description: FBM: label + packaging per order; 0 for FBA.

maxCostPerClick.description: keptBeforeAds × conversionRate, rounded down to the cent: the highest average cost per click at which the ads still pay. Null without conversionRate or a break-even.

monthlyGainOrLoss.description: earnedAfterCosts − adSpend, a month: negative means the ads cost more than they bring in (the engine's A5 sum). Null without adSpend and an ACoS.

orderTotal.description: What the buyer pays: price (FBA) or price + shipping charged (FBM), US dollars. Break-even ACoS divides by this.

storage.description: FBA with a packed size: one month of storage per unit (cubic feet × the season's monthly rate). Estimate; 0 otherwise.

storageRate.description: The season's monthly storage rate per cubic foot, US dollars (estimate); null when storage isn't counted.
